closure_gate: Parent-pinned completed whole-process outer receipt binds runner source; import only that verified source and call validate_closed_run(root,identity,read_observations=False). Require both original and independent captures. Rebind reporter/plan to pre-inference source identities before any truth read/literal evaluation. Failed inference is not silently accepted.

errors.positive_parameter_relative_percent: 100*(estimate/reference-1) where the positive reference is meaningful
errors.signed: physical estimate minus physical reference, in native units

failure_policy: New exclusive outputdirectory; retain failure receipt and partialoutputs, no automatic rerun/threshold relaxation. Successful completion requires unchanged inputs/source and stable outputaccounting after rendering.
figure_policy: Standardmatplotlib PNG+SVG, allsavedpoints, no smoothing, no fittedline or outcome-selectedzoom. Scales/title/legends statephysicalunits, sourcevsdecoded time and reference availability. Low-amplitude/static nuisance axes remain visible. All16 originalquantities are separately namedfromcurrentstates.

input_trace.preservation: All saved snapshots remain in numerical CSV; every point supplied to figures, no smoothing or outcome-selected subset. Initial public prior is explicitly separate from learned-point target screens.

interpretation: A flat or accurate point trace doesnot establish convergence, identifiability, calibrated uncertainty or real-device accuracy.
Approximate olderhistory and boundarytransport flags remain visible.
The fixed decoded-point Gaussian likelihood afterquantization is approximate; no noise inflation is introduced.
Exact nonlinear likelihood audits stay separate and use their predeclared threepoints/caps.
No production promotion or actual Cortex-M23 SRAM/timing claim.

optional_dense_current_truth.alignment: Header begin/count/version/sourceidentity andCRC required. Read header72+(n-begin)*208. Record stores event-enteringz,v[3],h andeventindex/within-count, notalways currentstate.
optional_dense_current_truth.availability_policy: Use only if already local under repo or supplied evidence root. No restore, network, history replay or RNG hydration. Otherwise currentv/h truth is unavailable afterinitial; plot complete estimates and explicit unavailable labels.
optional_dense_current_truth.reconstruction: Within-event elapsed=within_count*binary64(1/35); use source event-entry constant-current closedforms once perselectedrecord; atwithin0 currentstate equalsstored enteringstate. Verify reconstructedSOC agreesbitwise with scalartruth. Ignore stored RNG bytes.
optional_dense_current_truth.separate_accounting: Reporting-only reference evaluations; not the separately frozen original-model likelihood audits.

point_error_requirements.rule: Inclusive <= comparisons on actual saved postinitialblock grid. Firsthit and first all-later-saved-points-pass index are finite-window descriptive screens; missing/unavailable points are never successes. No universal nuisance parameter threshold.

scalar_truth.alignment: For next_index n>0 read byteoffset32*(n-1) and require embeddedindex n. No n0 binaryrecord; use initial source literal.
scalar_truth.reference: Original source physical truth, not redefined for quantized decoded input.

scope: Postclosure scoring/presentation only. No candidate changes, model replay, optimizer, prior evaluator, RNG, historical fitter, or uncertainty interval calculation.

static_truth.initial_state_rule: Original entering z0/v0/h0 use literal initial-state fields, never current-state truth_query.mean[11:16].
static_truth.method: After closure only, AST-parse the pinned module and literal-evaluate only the selected cell dictionary; never import/execute the generator module. At most one selected literal evaluation.
